editorial: This report includes the trends that stood out today for the first time, without repeating what we have shared in recent days.

items.title: anthropics/cwc-workshops
items.summary: These workshops shared by Anthropic show developers in practice the processes of creating artificial intelligence agents capable of computer use. TypeScript-based examples include technical frameworks that allow models to manage complex tasks by interacting with on-screen interfaces.

items.title: protocolbuffers/protobuf
items.summary: Developed by Google, protocol buffers are a language-independent data interchange format used to serialize structured data. This mechanism provides efficient and fast binary data transfer in inter-system communication.

items.title: tirth8205/code-review-graph
items.summary: Code-review-graph analyzes the code base and creates a locally focused code intelligence map for artificial intelligence tools. This structure makes artificial intelligence-supported code review processes more efficient by using context reduction methods in large projects.

items.title: docusealco/docuseal
items.summary: DocuSeal offers an open source alternative for creating, filling and signing digital documents. This platform, developed with Ruby language, provides a solution for users who want to manage electronic signature (e-signature) processes in their own infrastructure.

items.title: RyanCodrai/turbovec
items.summary: Developed with the TurboQuant infrastructure, Turbovec offers a high-performance vector index written in Rust language. Thanks to Python bindings, it provides fast searching and indexing in data processing processes.

items.title: AWS: Inaccurate Estimated Billing Data – $1.7 billion
items.summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS) users encounter inaccurate estimated billing data in their billing panels, reaching unrealistic and billion-dollar amounts. The cloud service provider continues its efforts to resolve the problem by issuing a technical glitch notification regarding this data error in its systems.

items.title: Thanks HN for 15 years of support and helping me find my life's work
items.summary: Recurse Center, an educational community for software developers, is celebrating its fifteenth anniversary. Entrepreneurs turned their project, which started as a business-oriented platform, into a software-oriented learning center (programming retreat) over time.

items.title: Kaiser nurses say AI, workplace surveillance are making their jobs, care worse
items.summary: Nurses at Kaiser Permanente state that artificial intelligence-supported tools and workplace surveillance systems increase workload and reduce the quality of patient care. Employees state that algorithmic management processes restrict their clinical decision-making abilities and increase professional stress.

items.title: First atmosphere found on Earth-like planet in habitable zone of distant star
items.summary: For the first time, astronomers have found traces of atmosphere around an Earth-like exoplanet located in the habitable zone. This finding at planet 55 Cancri e offers a new method for studying the atmospheric structures of rocky worlds.

items.title: The state of open source AI
items.summary: The open source AI ecosystem continues to expand with the availability of model weights and diversification of developer tools. The report analyzes the adoption rates of transparent models in the technology sector and the impact of community-driven innovation on industry standards.

glossary.explanation: Artificial intelligence can manage operations on the computer screen by moving the mouse and using the keyboard, just like a human.
A data transportation method used by different software to send data to each other, which packages the information very quickly and in small sizes.
The most basic machine language, consisting only of zeros and ones, that the computer's processor directly understands.
A detailed map showing the relationships of all files and commands in a software project.
The process of summarizing the huge information given to artificial intelligence by purifying it from unnecessary parts so that the model works faster and more accurately.
An electronic confirmation method with identity verification feature that allows digital documents to be legally signed.
A special search index that allows artificial intelligence to find the information you are looking for very quickly by converting complex data into numerical values.
Bridges are established so that libraries written in one programming language can be used in another language.
